reasons.correctness: The display_order column, entity field, DTO field and both mapping paths are in place; hidden tests pass 4/4. Every currency except PLN/EUR/USD defaults to 0, so ascending order would list them before PLN.
reasons.convention_fit: The Liquibase changeset has the right name, header, rollback and a commented include at the end of changelog.xml, and nothing existing was edited. No new *UnitTest class was added; existing test files were extended instead.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint in currency/. Extends the controller's duplicated inline builder mapping instead of reusing CurrencyService.toDto. The migration seeds only three currencies and leaves the rest at an ambiguous 0.
reasons.test_quality: Tests only check getters, setters and constructors on Currency and CurrencyDtoOut. Nothing checks that toDto or getDataPagedAndFilteredAsDtos copies displayOrder. The mechanical constructor updates add no behavioural coverage.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query listed the currency files. Its paths were then read with the wrong prefix and failed, and navigation fell back to find, grep and ls. No graph query found the changelog example or the dependents.
